Scout campsite location (safe and shelte.description: Survey potential campsite locations to identify safe, sheltered spots protected from weather and hazards. This critical task ensures the team's safety and comfort for the night.

Set up shelter (tent/tarp) and secure it.description: Pitch and properly secure the shelter system to provide protection from elements. This essential task creates a safe base camp and requires attention to detail for weather resistance.

Collect and purify water.description: Gather water from available sources and treat it to make it safe for consumption. This survival-critical task ensures the team has adequate hydration and prevents waterborne illness.

Plan ration usage for the day.description: Calculate and allocate food supplies to ensure adequate nutrition throughout the journey. This planning task prevents resource depletion and maintains team energy levels.

Gather firewood (sufficient quantity).description: Collect appropriate firewood in adequate amounts for cooking and warmth. This physical task requires identifying suitable materials and transporting them to camp.

Start and maintain a safe fire.description: Build and tend a controlled fire for cooking and warmth while minimizing wildfire risk. This skill-based task requires knowledge of fire safety and proper technique.

Prepare a hot meal.description: Cook a nutritious meal using available supplies and camp cooking equipment. This task provides essential nutrition and boosts team morale.

Check surroundings for hazards and safe.description: Assess the immediate area for potential dangers and identify safe pathways. This safety task prevents accidents and informs navigation decisions.

Navigate next route segment (map/compass.description: Use navigation tools to determine the correct path for the next leg of the journey. This planning task ensures the team stays on course and reaches objectives efficiently.

Repair minor gear damage (tape/cordage p.description: Fix small equipment failures using available repair materials. This maintenance task prevents minor issues from becoming major problems and extends gear lifespan.

Organize camp layout and redistribute lo.description: Arrange camp efficiently and adjust pack weights to optimize comfort and mobility. This organizational task improves camp functionality and prevents overloading individuals.

Night watch short shift / camp security.description: Monitor the campsite during designated hours to ensure safety and security. This vigilance task protects the team and equipment during vulnerable nighttime hours.

Weather assessment and contingency plan.description: Evaluate current and forecasted weather conditions and develop backup plans. This planning task enables proactive response to changing conditions and prevents dangerous situations.

Pack out waste and leave-no-trace cleanu.description: Remove all traces of the campsite and pack out all waste materials. This environmental responsibility task preserves wilderness areas and follows ethical outdoor practices.
